reviewers: Primary agent: supplied reference comparison, all peak views, mobile framing and unpaused playback samples
Peer agent: all eight front/three-quarter/profile peaks on frozen source and live wink/laughter
Model author: repeated geometry repairs, exact endpoint validation and all eight six-pose sequences

scope.method: Reviewed all eight expressions at six authored times, front/three-quarter/profile rest and peaks, mobile wink/surprise layouts, and seven screenshots per expression sampled from uninterrupted browser playback across a loop boundary. Inspected the eyes, teeth, nose, hair boundary, jaw and ear/profile join closely. Source hashes refer to the final frozen modules. This is sampled visual review, not continuous frame-by-frame or clinical validation.

repairs: Reshaped the facial silhouette, rounded chin, cheek planes, nasal bridge and tip while keeping one neutral identity.
Reduced resting eye aperture, modeled eyelid rims, added hazel irises, fine brows and lashes that follow eye closure.
Added volumetric rose lips, individual upper tooth crowns, separated nostril apertures and a sculpted ear concha.
Removed dental protrusions and hid the upper crowns in the rounded surprise aperture.
Repaired the jagged side-head seam by resolving surface derivatives at the oval boundary.
Rebuilt swept brunette hair with a low bun, fine native strands and face-framing tendrils; removed the old rectangular lower hair edge.
Added rest-anchored skin/lip microdetail and restrained color variation, plus a local softbox environment and portrait lights.
Refined neck taper, collar closure and portrait framing for desktop and mobile.

studies.observations: Mouth corners and cheeks lift together; the eyes soften and the dental arc stays behind the lips.
The inner brows lift, the lids lower, and the mouth corners descend without changing the portrait identity.
The brows draw inward while the eyes narrow and the lips press into a firmer line.
Wide eyelids and a stretched mouth separate the expression from surprise.
Raised brows, widened apertures and a rounded mouth distinguish surprise. Upper crowns remain hidden in this pose; the jaw and rear head stay joined in profile.
An asymmetric upper-lip and nose lift provide a distinct acting pose.
One eyelid closes completely with a clean crease, its iris disappears, and the other eye remains open. Both eyes recover at the loop boundary.
Lifted cheeks and narrowed lids accompany the broad mouth opening. Individual upper teeth remain behind the lips and do not emerge through the chin in reviewed views.

limitations: An original stylized adult woman, not a scanned or photorealistic portrait.
Expression presets are authored acting interpretations, not emotion recognition or diagnostic facial analysis.
Surface deformations illustrate feature coordination; they do not simulate individual biological muscle fibers.
Fine skin and hair detail are generated from native geometry and shaders; no photographs or image planes supply the rendered character.
